title: Marito Lama Tinyiketeleke Etlhelo Ka Muprofeta
intro: Etikweni ra le kule, murhumiwa la xiximekaka u langutane ni ku ariwa lokukulu hi mimfumo leyi fumaka ya nguva yoleyo. Hambi swi ri tano xirhendzevutana lexitsongo xa mimoya-xiviri leyi tinyiketeleke a xi yime etlhelo ka nandza loyi wa Allah, xi hisekela ku hlamula xirhambo xa Xikwembu. Ku khorwiseka ka vona loku nga tsekatsekiki a ku ta avanyisa tiko leri nga ni matimba naswona eku heteleleni a ku ta hlula matimba ya ku nga pfumeli.
clues: A hi ri ntlawa lowutsongo lowu tinyiketeleke, lowu hlanganeke hi ripfumelo ni xikongomelo.
Hi yime etlhelo ka murhumiwa wa xiyimo xa le henhla loyi a a ariwile hi valawuri va matimba va tiko ra vona.
Loko murhumiwa loyi a vutisa, ‘I vamani vaseketeri va mina endleleni ya Allah?’. hi hlamule handle ko kanakana.
Hi kombele murhumiwa loyi leswaku a lava nkhuvo a ri empfhukeni leswaku a tisa xitiyisekiso etimbilwini ta hina.
Exikarhi ka vanhu va nguva yoleyo, van’wana va pfumerile hi ku tirhisa rungula ra hina kasi van’wana va arile hi ku nonoka, kambe Allah u tiyise vapfumeri.
Hi hina va Hawwariyyun — vadyondzisiwa lava tinyiketeleke va Isa, lava endliweke va hlula hi nseketelo wa Allah.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
